text:
maria_support: FYI — we got an escalation from a customer who says outputs degraded after our speculative decoding rollout. They pasted a failing example and say it used to be accurate. Ticket CS-9831.

james_customer: "We started seeing weird outputs after the update yesterday. Short, confident but wrong answers, and sometimes the model invents page numbers for articles. It used to be accurate for our lookup use-case. We rolled back on our side and the issue went away. Can you confirm what's changed?"

maria_support: Repro payload (sanitized) from the customer:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-3b-draft-sampler-v2",
  "input": "What year was the first patent for the widget filed, and where can I find the reference?",
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "speculative": true,
  "max_tokens": 180
}
```
They got: "The first patent for the widget was filed in 1892. See Journal of Widgets, Vol. 2, p. 77." — which is wrong per their dataset.

elaine_ml: Note — we started enabling a draft/speculative path to reduce avg latency (~15%). Rollout started at 10% and we bumped to 25% yesterday across hosted. The draft sampler emits a draft hypothesis early and skips some KV fetches; it should trigger a fallback to full decode when uncertainty is high.

raj_product: @elaine_ml do we have any pre/post factuality telemetry? Customer reports hallucinations increased.

elaine_ml: We ran light internal QA (QA F1 -0.8% on our bench) but we did not match this customer's prompt distribution (heavy fact lookup + low temp). Pulled the inference logs for their session — suspicious pattern: draft path accepted hypothesis even when entropy > threshold. Example log:
```
[2026-03-27T13:12:01Z] request_id=cs9831 model=redwood-3b-draft-sampler-v2 rollout=25% path=draft hypothesis_accepted=true entropy=0.92 threshold=0.85 fallback=false
```
Entropy is high; fallback should have fired. Looks like an off-by-one or race in the sliding entropy window.

oncall_bot: @eng-runtime alerted. Creating incident INC-2026-217. Immediate mitigation suggested: flip speculative off or tighten gating.

nick_runtime: I'll own this. Pause the ramp and push config override to force fallback for that model tag. Need confirmation of rollout scope (elaine said 25%). I can push an override in ~10m.

deploy-bot: Rolling config change: models/redwood-3b-draft-sampler-v2 -> speculative.enabled=false. Started. :rotating_light:

maria_support: Customer retried and reports responses look like before. "Looks normal now, thanks — can you share root cause and timeline?" They also asked whether they'd be eligible for credits.

elaine_ml: Draft root cause (working): race between draft acceptance commit and entropy calc because of a sliding-window off-by-one introduced in commit 0f9c2. Result: premature acceptance of low-confidence draft tokens. Impact: correctness regressions on reference-heavy prompts, rollout at 25% for ~3h.

raj_product: Action items —
- eng-runtime: revert or patch commit 0f9c2 or keep speculative off until fix (owner: nick_runtime)
- ML: expand QA to include customer-like prompt distributions and add a factuality regression alert (owner: elaine_ml)
- Support: notify affected customers and escalate billing/credit requests (owner: maria_support)
- Product: produce postmortem + dashboard for speculative path metrics (owner: raj_product)

nick_runtime: Short-term: config override is live. I'll cut a hotfix branch to fix the window/race and add unit tests. ETA: PR in ~4h, canary in staging in ~8h, prod patch 24-48h depending on tests. Meanwhile speculative is disabled in prod for that model.

maria_support: Customer wants a plain-language note to send to their stakeholders. Draft to send: "We rolled out an experimental speculative decoding path to reduce latency; a bug caused early draft outputs to be accepted instead of falling back to full decode when uncertain. We have disabled speculative decoding for your endpoint while we fix the issue." Is that OK?

elaine_ml: That's accurate. Also recommend adding a per-org opt-out flag for experimental runtime features so enterprise customers can avoid fractional rollouts.

nick_runtime: Adding org-scoped feature-flag to backlog and the rollout playbook.

maria_support: I'll follow up with the customer and log a request for potential SLA credit. Finance contact will weigh in.

james_customer: Thanks for the fast response. Please let me know when the fix is deployed; we need stable behavior for production.

raj_product: We'll add a hard alarm: any >1% drop in nightly QA factuality triggers an automatic pause of rollouts. Elaine to own.

elaine_ml: Will add nightly regression runs that include customer-like prompts and alert #eng-runtime and #customer-success.

deploy-bot: config change complete: speculative.enabled=false for redwood-3b-draft-sampler-v2.

nick_runtime: PR created: hotfix/fix-entropy-window (link withheld). Assigning INC-2026-217 to eng-runtime. I'll post updates as tests run.

maria_support: Closing support loop for now; will reopen if customer sees anything after the patch. :white_check_mark:
